links.outcome: Vulnerability of medical imaging deep learning models to adversarial perturbation attacks (white box and black box)
links.effect: Proposed attack generates perturbations focused on the lesion region that attack medical deep learning systems; experiments on three medical image types demonstrate its performance. No numeric results in the abstract.
links.quote: The performance and specificity of the proposed attack method are demonstrated by conducting extensive experiments on three different types of medical images.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing the vulnerability of medical image classification models to a novel adversarial attack (robustness/security evaluation).
